about: Recording manifest: the fixed script as scenes, one narration clip per scene, and the parts the film is cut into. The narration, score and film tools read it with --manifest, and tools/player/build_parts.py reads its parts with --parts. The player needs the parts list: for a film not cut into parts, give one part holding every scene, and give build_parts.py a --max at least the film's length. spoken_text_exact is the only source of words, captions included: copy it from the script word for word, never edit it here, and verify and align the narration again after any change. The sample lines below only show the shape.
title: Sample opening

scenes.title: Venice
scenes.spoken_text_exact: This is sample narration for the first scene. Venice at dusk, seen across a canal. Four things fill the picture: the water and the domes, then the gondolas and their lanterns.

scenes.spoken_text_exact: This is sample narration for the second scene. A fortress above the sea at first light. Othello walks alone into the gate, and the scene ends on a held picture.
